subject: The 3AM spiral that nearly broke me
preview_text: I built this feature at 2AM when I couldn't breathe. Open Fresh Start for 30-second relief.
body_paragraphs: I remember it like it was yesterday. 3AM, staring at the ceiling, heart racing, my phone in my hand—ready to text them. That moment when you know you shouldn't, but the loneliness is so loud it drowns out every rational thought. You've been there, right? That split second where the only thing between you and a mistake is a single tap.

Here's what I learned the hard way: those 3AM spirals aren't a sign you're weak. They're a sign you're human, still wired to a person who no longer deserves that space in your head. But you don't have to white-knuckle through it alone. The first time I tried our emergency mode, I felt something I hadn't felt in weeks—relief. In under 30 seconds, it gave me a step-by-step path back to myself, without judgment, without the urge to reach out.

That feature is called Emergency Mode, and it's already on your phone, right now, inside Fresh Start. It's a lifeline for those moments when your brain lies to you and says reaching out will fix it. It won't. But this will—a guided breathing exercise, replacement thought, and a message from someone who's been there. It's the difference between spiraling and steering.

Open the app, find Emergency Mode, and give it 30 seconds. Just once. See if it doesn't quiet the noise. P.S. Most users who try it once use it again within 24 hours—and they never send that 3AM text.
